name: Gakin the Darkbinder
summary: Beneath The Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind, Gakin the Darkbinder tests those who seek the warlock arts. He teaches aspiring Alliance warlocks to summon and bind demons.

sections.title: A Secret Gathering Place
sections.body: Below The Slaughtered Lamb's taproom, a cellar gathers those who study shadow and fel. Summoning circles and grim tomes fill the crypt-like room, kept from the eyes that watch Stormwind's open mage sanctuaries. There, Gakin teaches young warlocks discipline and restraint before they call forces they may not control.

sections.title: Master of Demons
sections.body: Gakin teaches demonology and the rites for binding demons. Those who earn his notice travel across the kingdom for rare things, among them stolen bloodstone talismans and corrupt wood from dark forests. When all is gathered, Gakin watches over their work in the crypt's summoning circle. There, novices face voidwalkers and succubi in trials that test their will and risk their lives.

sections.title: Betrayals and Loose Ends
sections.body: Surena Caledon, once Gakin's apprentice, fled into the wilds with a valuable Bloodstone Choker. Her betrayal could reveal the warlock circle to Stormwind's guards. So Gakin sends loyal followers to recover lost artifacts and silence loose ends before the authorities take notice.

faq.q: Where can I find Gakin the Darkbinder?
faq.answer: Gakin waits beneath The Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. Enter the tavern and take the downward ramp at the back. Follow the stone tunnels to the summoning circle in the lowest crypt.

faq.q: What does Gakin the Darkbinder do?
faq.answer: Gakin mentors Alliance warlocks and tests novices with trials across Azeroth. He teaches them to summon and bind demons such as the Voidwalker and Succubus.

faq.q: Why are warlocks allowed under The Slaughtered Lamb?
faq.answer: Stormwind forbids demonic magic and deeply mistrusts it. Beneath The Slaughtered Lamb, warlocks work in secrecy, hidden from guards and citizens. Stormwind tolerates them as a dangerous covert asset.
Surena Caledon was Gakin's former student, and she stole a powerful Bloodstone Choker from him. Her betrayal threatens the hidden order, so Gakin sends warlocks to track her down.

faq.q: Which demons does Gakin help summon?
faq.answer: Gakin oversees rites to bind Voidwalkers and Succubi. He guides warlocks as they summon the demons into the underground circle and subdue them.

faq.q: Who is Strahad and why does Gakin mention him?
aliases: where does gakin send me next
faq.answer: Strahad Farsan is an experienced warlock in the Ratchet hills of Kalimdor. After a student masters Gakin's basic binding rites, Gakin sends them across the sea to continue their dark studies with Strahad.

angles.text: As a human or gnome warlock, you can learn from Gakin in Stormwind's crypts to summon and bind a voidwalker and succubus.
Gakin's hidden circle beneath the capital reveals the compromises made in the heart of the Alliance.
